# Extract all function/method declarations from internal/ (non-test)
python3 - << 'PY'
import os, re
from collections import defaultdict

root = "/bench/repo/internal"
decls = []
func_re = re.compile(r'^func\s+(?:\(([^)]+)\)\s+)?(\w+)\s*\(')

for dirpath, _, files in os.walk(root):
    for f in files:
        if not f.endswith('.go') or f.endswith('_test.go'):
            continue
        path = os.path.join(dirpath, f)
        with open(path) as fh:
            for i, line in enumerate(fh, 1):
                m = func_re.match(line.strip() if False else line)
                # match at start after optional whitespace
                m = re.match(r'^func\s+(?:\(([^)]+)\)\s+)?(\w+)\s*\(', line)
                if m:
                    recv, name = m.group(1), m.group(2)
                    rel = path.replace("/bench/repo/", "")
                    decls.append((name, recv, rel, i))

print(f"Total declarations: {len(decls)}")
print("Unique names:", len(set(d[0] for d in decls)))
# show all names
from collections import Counter
names = Counter(d[0] for d in decls)
print("Most common declared names (collisions):")
for n,c in names.most_common(20):
    print(f"  {n}: {c}")
print("\nAll declarations:")
for name, recv, rel, i in sorted(decls, key=lambda x: x[0]):
    r = f"({recv.strip()}) " if recv else ""
    print(f"  {r}{name} — {rel}:{i}")
